hypotheses.reasoning: index-worker crashes with RangeError (call stack overflow) in expandReferences while processing msg-873569 at catalog.updates offset 363506 (#1485, #1518, #1567). Each restart (#1486, #1519, #1569, backoff 10s/20s/40s) re-consumes the same offset and crashes again, so the consumer never advances past this message. This is the originating fault; the CrashLoopBackOff and growing catalog.updates lag follow from it. The index-worker had no errors before 03:54:58 and processed batches normally up to #1480. Report-cron failures (#595 onward, ModuleNotFoundError: pandas after deploy report-cron:2026.10.2) are a separate, unrelated job failure and do not explain the index-worker crash. Search-api, web-bff, catalog-svc and catalog-db show no errors. The likely cause is a malformed or self-referencing/deeply nested record in the message payload. data_integrity is a plausible alternative if the bad record came from a bad upstream write.

verdict.recommendedAction: Quarantine or skip offset 363506 (msg-873569) on catalog.updates, e.g. move it to a dead-letter topic or advance the consumer group offset, so index-worker can drain the backlog. Add a recursion depth guard or cycle detection in expandReferences. Trace where msg-873569 was produced in catalog-svc to find the malformed or circular reference. Separately, fix report-cron:2026.10.2 by restoring the pandas dependency in the image.
